## `neuro.math.imul`

Static method on `Math`.

> Returns the result of 32-bit multiplication of two numbers.

## Signatures

```ts
imul(input: { x: number; y: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Math.imul` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
